[[File:RubicundEye.jpg|250px|thumb|Region of space around the Rubicund Eye.]]
The '''Rubicund Eye''' was an aging observatory located in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], below the system's orbital plane. It observed [[Extragalactic/Legends|locations]] [[Galactic Rim/Legends|beyond]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of the criminal [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] cartel often terrorized the area around the observatory; therefore [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were cautioned to stay clear of this area.
